I resolved this years ago and am astounded you're going to continue down the non-deterministic path. This makes the java API useless as is in a production system. See: https://github.com/KognitionAI/pilecv4j/blob/master/lib-image/src/main/java/ai/kognition/pilecv4j/image/CvMat.java and particularly the javadoc
While migrating to java.lang.ref.Cleaner technically resolves the finalize() deprecation
column2: it remains an architectural antipattern for high-performance native bindings. Relying on the JVM's GC schedule to trigger native deallocation is non-deterministic by nature; in memory-constrained or high-throughput systems
column3: this frequently leads to native OOMs even when the JVM heap is mostly empty.

column2: the industry is moving toward explicit
